definitions.explanation: A romantic relationship between two people.

examples.english: To have a wide circle of friends.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}は{交際|こうさい}している。
{彼|かれ}らは3{年間|ねんかん}{交際|こうさい}した{後|あと}、{先月|せんげつ}{結婚|けっこん}した。
examples.english: After dating for three years, they got married last month.

notes:
{交際|こうさい} covers both social and romantic relationships.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {交際|こうさい}する (to associate, to date)
- {交際|こうさい}が{広|ひろ}い/狭い (wide/narrow social circle)
- {交際|こうさい}{費|ひ} (entertainment expenses)
- {交際|こうさい}{相手|あいて} (partner, date)

NOTE: Can refer to both friendships and romantic relationships depending on context.
